issue.body:
## Problem

Maintainers still choose among three server release forms and run native build and submit separately. Original PR #401 contains a useful simplification, but its recovery guidance predates the CI safeguards now merged in #434. Recover that outcome on current master without weakening publication or credential boundaries.

Authority: the original human release-cleanup request and active-backlog progression, followed by the coordinator's accepted intake and explicit implementation dispatch.

## Requirements and acceptance

1. Provide one manual **Release server** entrypoint with `patch`, `minor`, `major`, `resume`, and `image-only`. Preserve exact request/run/attempt/ref/source verification and operation-specific permissions; reject unknown or mixed inputs. Remove four duplicate request/handler files only after equivalent routing exists.
2. `resume` verifies the exact merged prepared source and reuses publication without a new version. `image-only` recovers only the image, never OTA/deployment; `publish_latest` defaults false and is allowed only for the highest stable tag. Preserve immutable receipt verification and historical `cut-release-handler.yml`, `publish-release-handler.yml`, and `container-handler.yml` certificate identities, including current allow/revoke enforcement.
3. Preserve #434's complete exact-candidate CI gate, PR/tested-base binding, bounded approval wait, failure/missing/stale rejection, final ref rechecks and explicit publication dependency. Retain blocked validated candidates; retry only with unchanged refs, and reconcile drift before another cut. Never use post-merge recovery for an unmerged candidate.
4. `native:release` awaits existing build/sign/verification before submit/readback; failed builds cannot submit. `--skip-build` re-verifies retained artifacts without rebuilding, re-signing or loading signing settings. Keep consuming-stage credential isolation, internal tracks, the internal submit worker, and manual build/install/OTA choices.
5. Add a concise deployment chooser and consistent maintained guidance. Keep the current weekly/manual package-audit policy and PR container OS checks. Demonstrate request, recovery, receipt, CI and native failure/retry boundaries with maintained non-UI tests; keep historical screenshots and one-off records outside product history.

## Implementation plan

Follow the [source-backed pre-implementation plan and retention contract](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/f44643d0bdfd2ec4a26e14b5571e5ba94dd8cb07/pr401-recovery/README.md). Use isolated branch `mchartier/release-entrypoints-recovery` from verified current master. Selectively port the server/native entrypoints, reconcile recovery guidance with #434, and validate the request, recovery and credential boundaries with maintained release/native/deployment checks and hosted PR CI. Obtain independent full-scope QA before coordinator readiness.

Coordinate `deploy/README.md` with #439 and README/package edits with #404 before shared-file changes; import neither branch. Implementation and a draft successor PR are authorized. No broad hygiene, Firebase/GCP work, original-PR closure, real release/build/upload/provider action or settings change is authorized.

Keep results and workflow history in the [execution checkpoint](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/issues/440#issuecomment-6031572461), its retained records, and the [preserved description history](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/issues/440#issuecomment-6031805319).

## Implementing Codex task

Sole native implementation owner: verified task ID `01a114af-c6d1-705c-ade9-39553731d038`. Preserve the [original cloud owner's idle handoff and ownership](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/f44643d0bdfd2ec4a26e14b5571e5ba94dd8cb07/pr401-recovery/owner-handoff.json); no original native UUID existed.

## Implementing PR

Current PR: [#441](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/pull/441), with native `Closes #440` linkage.

Historical, superseded PR: [#401](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/pull/401), replaced by #441. See the [replacement record](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/pull/401#issuecomment-6032144733) and [retained original source and evidence](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/f44643d0bdfd2ec4a26e14b5571e5ba94dd8cb07/pr401-recovery/README.md).
